sections.title: The Age of Influence: Society and the Young Adult
sections.description: This introduction to literary study examines a compelling literary theme. The theme's function within specific historical contexts, within literary history generally, and within contemporary culture, will all be emphasized. In presenting a range of materials and perspectives, this course is an ideal introduction to literary study. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
